CanvasHistoryRecord: one canvas, many named views
|
+-- snapshots[id]: immutable canvas checkpoints
|   `-- document + diagramBindings + personal view
|
`-- canvasViews
    +-- saved[parentId]: CanvasView
    |   +-- create(name) captures the current head immediately
    |   +-- checkpointIds[0] = startCheckpointId
    |   `-- finalCheckpointId: saved endpoint; save advances it
    |       +-- fork(name) -> one child, then opens it
    |       |   `-- parentViewId + forkCheckpointId pin its origin
    |       `-- alternatives(names) -> sibling children
    |           +-- alternativeGroupId ties the siblings together
    |           `-- each starts at that same saved endpoint
    |
    +-- activeViewId: view currently being edited
    |   `-- open(id)
    |       +-- stash old head in workingCopies[oldId]
    |       +-- resume workingCopies[id] or finalCheckpointId
    |       `-- clone target as new head; retain current camera
    |
    +-- branch decisions
    |   +-- keep(child): save it; archive siblings and descendants
    |   `-- discard(view): archive it and its descendants
    |
    `-- canvasViewComparison(id)
        `-- compare startCheckpointId with finalCheckpointId
